[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Music Major in Music Management","groupId":"ff6feb28-3fa0-4681-8a8c-01956cd93348","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music degree with a major in music management.

","groupId":"a6aee230-58c5-4138-a185-01956cd93348","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"e703d366-ef63-4bff-ae84-01956cd9b069","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"f87f4624-7bb3-4427-9e91-01956cd9b069","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"cca4a1d3-e82f-4945-ace5-01956cda47ee","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars

","groupId":"9b7506b9-c85a-48e6-a286-01956cda47ef","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"2126da22-687d-4a87-919a-01956cdab57f","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"87f51a2a-6a53-4d81-8a34-01956cdab57f","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"8f86e2ad-0565-4e3c-a485-01956ce131ba","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"9706d194-9411-4f80-bb68-01956ce131bb","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"e877cf8a-7cf2-4d28-a70b-01956ce131bb","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"3abdbcdd-84cb-412c-bbe4-01956ce131bb","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"427296a7-288d-4ad9-8fda-01956ce37941","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

Students are required to complete:

1) Eight units and eight semesters of MPER, MCOM and MHIS, based on placement auditions.

2) Maximum of 15 elective units.

3)Maximum of 4 Music electives.

4) MMGT 050 must be taken twice.
